summary: Bound the initial transcript mount to six source rows, preserving the newest prompt and complete reasoning runs

replay.detail: Presentation only; no claim replay or projection rebuild.

schema.detail: No database, replicated vocabulary or client wire changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or admission rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Transcript history initially mounts six source rows rather than two complete turns. The newest prompt remains available and a contiguous reasoning run crossing the boundary remains whole. Existing explicit history controls reveal earlier rows. Current viewport, runtime, retained panes, sidebar and composer ownership remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon interruption or startup work.

manual.detail: No configuration or migration. Use the existing history controls to reveal older rows.

recovery.detail: No stored state changes. Older builds retain their previous transcript mounting policy.
